{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Remove rows where biomarker_baseline is -999.0, as they represent invalid data
# This ensures we only use valid baseline measurements
valid_data = data[data['biomarker_baseline'] != -999.0]

# Check that we still have baseline and follow-up measurements for all remaining rows
valid_baseline = valid_data['biomarker_baseline'].isna().sum()
valid_final = valid_data['biomarker_final'].isna().sum()

valid_baseline, valid_final"}
